questions.q: Why does this platform create two separate warehouses, transforming_wh and reporting_wh, instead of one shared warehouse?
options: Snowflake requires at least two warehouses per account
So a heavy dbt build never makes a business user's Power BI query wait in a queue — the two workloads never share compute
Because warehouses can only run one query at a time regardless of size
To reduce the total Snowflake bill to zero
questions.explain: Separate warehouses isolate the bursty dbt build workload from steady BI query traffic so neither competes with the other for compute.

questions.q: In Snowflake's built-in role hierarchy, which role is the typical parent that custom roles like TRANSFORMER get granted up to?
options: PUBLIC
SYSADMIN
USERADMIN
A custom role has no parent in the hierarchy
questions.explain: SYSADMIN creates and manages warehouses, databases, and other objects, and is the real parent almost every custom role is slotted under via GRANT ROLE ... TO ROLE sysadmin.

questions.q: What is the TRANSFORMER role's job in this platform, as set up in this lesson?
options: It's the role Power BI and business users connect as
It's the role dbt itself runs as across every environment, eventually given read access to RAW and write access to DEV/PROD
It's a warehouse size setting
It only exists to manage GitHub Actions secrets
questions.explain: TRANSFORMER is dbt's own role; ANALYST is the separate, narrower role for Power BI and people, read-only against finished marts.

questions.q: Why does ANALYST not get USAGE granted on transforming_wh?
options: Because ANALYST should never be able to run compute-heavy dbt builds on the warehouse meant for transformation work — keeping the two roles' compute scoped to their own job
Because Snowflake doesn't allow more than one role per warehouse
Because ANALYST is a system-defined role that can't be granted anything
Because transforming_wh does not actually exist until Chapter 6
questions.explain: Scoping each role to its own warehouse keeps the workload isolation real — ANALYST has no reason to ever run on the dbt build warehouse.

questions.q: What does AUTO_SUSPEND = 60 on transforming_wh control?
options: The maximum number of rows a query can return
How many seconds of idle time pass before the warehouse stops running (and billing) compute
How often dbt automatically re-runs all models
The number of users allowed to use the warehouse simultaneously
questions.explain: AUTO_SUSPEND sets the idle timeout before Snowflake suspends a warehouse, which stops compute billing until it's needed again.
